svg.text: PRELIMINARY. NOT A PCB. NOT CONTINUITY-TESTED.
U_P28 is PicoROM-28 rev 1.10. /CE strapped low. OEB is /OE. No external HCT.
2 Module power and what this sheet is not
NO EXTERNAL HCT245. BUFFERS ARE INSIDE THE MODULE.
ASSUMED VSW = 5 V on pin 28. Confirm 4.5-5.5 V, spikes included, before power. No 7805. VBAT open.
Module Schottkys OR USB and pin 28. This sheet does not short USB to VSW.
Stock firmware P28_27C512_70ns. Address GPIO0-15, data GPIO16-23. Not a bare Pico map.
Upstream quotes 70 ns / 40 ns on its own bench. This repo has no robot scope capture.
